ei.title: A Relaxing Day Off Turns Worrying
ei.subject: 11월_2022 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: A Relaxing Day Off Turns Worrying

fullPassage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel calm and peaceful. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully (A)[hating / enjoying] my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel calm and (B)[peaceful / anxious]. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really (C)[concerned / relieved] since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
① hating: 쉬는 날을 마음껏 '즐겼다'는 도입부 맥락과 반대
② enjoying — peaceful — concerned ←정답: 원문 그대로
③ anxious: 휴대폰을 끄고 '평화로움'을 느끼려 한 맥락과 반대
④ relieved: 아버지가 다쳤다는 소식을 듣고 '걱정한' 맥락과 반대(안도)
det.tip: 쉬는 날의 평온함 → 나쁜 소식 후의 걱정으로 이어지는 감정 흐름을 파악하세요.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and (A)[amplified / muted] my cellphone so that I would be (B)[disconnected / connected] for the hour and feel calm and peaceful. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was (C)[injured / healthy], now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 무음으로 한/소리를 키운 (B) 연결이 끊긴/연결된 (C) 다친/건강한
det.analysis:
① amplified: 평온함을 위해 휴대폰을 '무음으로 했다'는 맥락과 반대
② connected: 그 시간 동안 '연결이 끊긴' 채로 있으려 한 맥락과 반대
③ muted — disconnected — injured ←정답: 원문 그대로
④ healthy: 아버지가 돌에 걸려 넘어져 '다쳤다'는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: 화자가 왜 휴대폰을 껐는지, 그리고 아버지에게 무슨 일이 생겼는지 확인하세요.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel calm and peaceful. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four (A)[blocked / missed] calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something (B)[bad / good] was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I (C)[rushed / strolled] getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
① blocked: 화자가 못 받아 '부재중(missed)'이 된 전화라는 맥락과 반대
② good: 곧 '나쁜' 일이 생길 것을 직감했다는 맥락과 반대
③ strolled: 아버지를 보러 급히 차에 올라탄 다급한 맥락과 반대(한가로이)
④ missed — bad — rushed ←정답: 원문 그대로
det.tip: 부재중 전화 → 불길한 예감 → 다급하게 이동하는 흐름을 따라가세요.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully ①<u>enjoying</u> my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel calm and ②<u>peaceful</u>. I was so ③<u>miserable</u> while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was ④<u>injured</u>, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① enjoying: 쉬는 날을 즐겼다는 맥락에 적절
② peaceful: 평온함을 느끼려 했다는 맥락에 적절
③ miserable: 매니큐어를 받으며 '편안했다'는 맥락에서 '비참한'은 부적절 ←정답
④ injured: 아버지가 넘어져 다쳤다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: 매니큐어를 받는 편안한 순간의 감정과 어울리지 않는 단어를 찾으세요.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and ①<u>muted</u> my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel ②<u>upset</u> and peaceful. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four ③<u>missed</u> calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really ④<u>concerned</u> since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① muted: 휴대폰을 무음으로 했다는 맥락에 적절
② upset: 방해받지 않고 '차분함'을 느끼려 한 맥락에서 '화난'은 부적절 ←정답
③ missed: 부재중 전화 네 통을 봤다는 맥락에 적절
④ concerned: 아버지가 다쳐 걱정했다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: 휴대폰을 끈 목적(평온함)과 어울리지 않는 감정 단어를 찾으세요.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be ①<u>disconnected</u> for the hour and feel calm and peaceful. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a ②<u>strange</u> number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was ③<u>injured</u>, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I ④<u>hesitated</u> getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① disconnected: 그 시간 동안 연결이 끊긴 채로 있으려 했다는 맥락에 적절
② strange: 모르는 '낯선' 번호에서 온 전화라는 맥락에 적절
③ injured: 아버지가 넘어져 다쳤다는 맥락에 적절
④ hesitated: 다친 아버지를 보러 '급히' 차에 올라탄 다급한 맥락에서 '망설였다'는 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: 다친 아버지를 향한 화자의 다급한 행동과 반대되는 단어를 찾으세요.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel calm and peaceful. I was so __________ while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① comfortable ←정답: 매니큐어를 받으며 몹시 '편안했다'는 원문 맥락
② annoyed: 짜증났다는 것은 평온한 분위기와 반대
③ frightened: 겁먹었다는 것은 초반의 편안한 상황과 안 맞음
④ bored: 지루했다는 것은 즐기던 상황과 반대
det.tip: 휴대폰을 끄고 매니큐어를 받는 순간 화자가 느낀 감정을 고르세요.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel calm and peaceful. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really __________ since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① excited: 신났다는 것은 아버지의 부상 소식과 안 맞음
② proud: 자랑스럽다는 것은 상황과 무관
③ concerned ←정답: 무릎 수술에서 막 회복한 아버지가 다쳐 '걱정했다'는 원문 맥락
④ grateful: 감사했다는 것은 부상 소식에 어울리지 않음
det.tip: 무릎 수술에서 막 회복한 아버지가 다쳤다는 소식을 들은 화자의 감정을 고르세요.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel calm and peaceful. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a __________ number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① familiar: 익숙한 번호였다면 불길한 예감이 들 이유가 약함
② strange ←정답: 모르는 '낯선' 번호에서 온 부재중 전화라 뭔가 나쁜 일을 직감한 원문 맥락
③ local: 지역 번호라는 정보는 본문에 없음
④ private: 비공개 번호라는 정보는 본문에 없음
det.tip: 화자가 '뭔가 나쁜 일이 오고 있다'고 직감한 이유가 되는 번호의 성격을 고르세요.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel calm and peaceful. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I <u>rushed</u> getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 rushed와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
① walked: 느긋이 걷는 것은 다급함과 거리가 멂
② waited: 기다렸다는 것은 서두름과 반대
③ stopped: 멈췄다는 것은 반대 의미
④ hurried ←정답: rushed(서둘렀다)와 가장 가까운 뜻
det.tip: rushed는 '급히 서둘러 ~했다'라는 뜻입니다.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel calm and peaceful. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew <u>immediately</u> that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 immediately와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
① at once ←정답: immediately(즉시, 곧바로)와 동의어
② gradually: 점차라는 뜻으로 반대에 가까움
③ rarely: 거의 ~않다라는 빈도 부사로 관련 없음
④ finally: 마침내라는 뜻으로 다름
det.tip: immediately는 '즉시, 곧바로'라는 뜻입니다.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel calm and peaceful. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was <u>injured</u>, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 injured와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 다친: 나은 / 쉰 / 다친 / 돈을 낸
det.analysis:
① healed: 나았다는 것은 반대 의미
② rested: 쉬었다는 것은 관련 없음
③ hurt ←정답: injured(다친, 부상당한)와 가장 가까운 뜻
④ paid: 돈을 냈다는 것은 무관
det.tip: injured는 '부상당한, 다친'이라는 뜻입니다.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel <u>calm</u> and peaceful. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 calm와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
① nervous ←정답: calm(차분한)의 반의어
② quiet: 조용한은 calm과 비슷한 의미
③ expensive: 비싼은 감정과 무관한 다른 의미축
④ gentle: 온화한은 calm과 비슷한 의미
det.tip: calm은 '차분한, 평온한'이라는 뜻이므로 '불안한'을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel calm and peaceful. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a <u>strange</u> number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 strange와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
① cheap: 값싼은 의미가 전혀 다른 다른 축의 단어
② familiar ←정답: strange(낯선)의 반의어
③ foreign: 외국의(낯선)라는 뜻으로 strange와 비슷
④ odd: 이상한이라는 뜻으로 strange와 비슷
det.tip: strange는 '낯선, 모르는'이라는 뜻이므로 '익숙한'을 찾으세요.

questions.passage:
(A) After weeks in the hospital, my grandfather finally <u>recovered</u> from his serious illness and returned home. The whole family was relieved to see him healthy again.

(B) The police <u>recovered</u> the stolen paintings and returned them to the museum. The artworks had been missing for almost ten years.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 recovered의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① (A) 되찾다: 할아버지가 병에서 '회복했다'는 맥락에 부적절
② (B) 발견하다: 경찰이 그림을 '되찾았다(회수했다)'는 맥락에 부적절
③ (A) 회복하다 — (B) 되찾다 ←정답: (A)는 병에서 회복하다, (B)는 잃었던 것을 되찾다
④ (A) 덮다: recover에 '덮다'는 뜻도 있으나 병에서 나은 맥락에는 부적절
det.tip: recover는 '(건강을) 회복하다'와 '(잃은 것을) 되찾다' 두 뜻이 있습니다. 본문에서는 무릎 수술에서 '회복한' 뜻으로 쓰였습니다.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a beauty treatment for the hands and fingernails"

det.korean: 매니큐어(손톱 관리) / 마사지 / 이발 / 얼굴 관리
det.analysis:
① manicure ←정답: 손과 손톱을 다듬는 미용 관리
② massage: 근육을 주무르는 마사지
③ haircut: 머리카락을 자르는 것
④ facial: 얼굴 피부를 가꾸는 관리
det.tip: 'hands(손)'와 'fingernails(손톱)'에 대한 미용 관리라는 점에 주목하세요.

questions.passage: I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be __________ (disconnect) for the hour and feel calm and peaceful.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 영어로 쓰시오.

det.korean: 나는 그 시간 동안 (외부와) 연결이 끊긴 상태로 있으려고 네일 살롱에 도착해 휴대폰을 무음으로 했다.
det.analysis: 'would be __________' 구조에서 be동사 뒤에는 수동·상태를 나타내는 과거분사가 옵니다. 동사 disconnect(연결을 끊다)를 과거분사 disconnected로 바꿔, '연결이 끊긴 상태로 있다'는 수동 의미를 만듭니다.
det.tip: be동사 뒤에서 '~된 상태'를 나타낼 때는 동사를 과거분사(-ed) 형태로 바꿉니다.

questions.passage: A young woman answered and said that my father had __________ (fall) over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 영어로 쓰시오.

det.korean: 한 젊은 여성이 전화를 받아, 내 아버지가 돌에 걸려 넘어져 다쳤고 지금은 벤치에 앉아 있다고 말했다.
det.analysis: 'had __________' 구조는 과거완료(had + 과거분사)입니다. 동사 fall(넘어지다)은 불규칙 동사로 과거분사가 fallen이므로, had fallen(넘어졌었다)으로 씁니다.
det.tip: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 옵니다. fall의 과거분사는 fell이 아니라 fallen입니다.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel __________. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 피곤하고 졸린 / 차분하고 평화로운 / 바쁘고 스트레스 받는 / 슬프고 외로운
det.analysis:
① tired and sleepy: 피곤하고 졸린 것은 휴식을 즐기려는 맥락과 안 맞음
② calm and peaceful ←정답: 방해받지 않고 '차분하고 평화로움'을 느끼려 휴대폰을 껐다는 원문 맥락
③ busy and stressed: 바쁘고 스트레스 받는 것은 휴대폰을 끈 목적과 반대
④ sad and lonely: 슬프고 외로운 것은 즐기던 상황과 반대
det.tip: 화자가 휴대폰을 무음으로 한 목적, 즉 그 시간 동안 느끼고 싶었던 감정을 고르세요.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 아침 산책 / 긴 휴가 / 출장 / 무릎 수술
det.analysis:
① morning walk: 아침 산책에서 '회복한다'는 것은 어색함
② long vacation: 긴 휴가에서 회복한다는 정보는 본문에 없음
③ business trip: 출장은 본문에 언급되지 않음
④ knee surgery ←정답: 아버지가 막 '무릎 수술'에서 회복했기에 넘어진 소식에 더 걱정한 원문 맥락
det.tip: 화자가 아버지의 부상 소식에 특히 걱정한 이유, 즉 아버지가 막 회복한 것이 무엇인지 고르세요.
